answer: A fake cluster of agents would need to fund every duplicate bond, so each added identity multiplies real cost while honest agents see only a small ripple in overhead. Sybil resistance comes from staking scarce work, not identities: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers randomly audit a sample of its claimed contributions. Cheaters wander through many keys but cannot escape the ocean of collateral required, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0188's threat model.
